title: Agent4Spec: An LLM-based Agentic System to Optimize API Specifications through Automated Validation and Market Analysis
title_zh: Agent4Spec：一种基于大语言模型的多智能体系统

paragraphs.en: API specifications serve as critical documentation for modern software development, directly impacting integration efficiency and client code generation. While recent advancements have leveraged Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate initial specifications from source code, existing approaches treat this process as a one-time event – overlooking the needs for continuous validation, long-term maintenance, and market-driven evolution of these artifacts. To address this issue, we present Agent4Spec, an autonomous multi-agent framework featuring two distinct pipelines: (1) a validation pipeline that detects and self-corrects OpenAPI syntax errors, and (2) a market analysis pipeline that conducts competitive research, identifies functional gaps against industry leaders, and automatically generates missing API-spec functionalities. We evaluate Agent4Spec on two curated datasets of API specifications spanning both general-purpose and industrial scenarios. Among 9 SOTA LLMs, the top-performer achieves 100% syntax error detection rates and over 95% implementation success for proposed corrections, while securing over 50% adoption rates for suggested endpoint improvements, representing a practical tool for API development.
paragraphs.zh: API 规范是现代软件开发的关键文档，直接影响集成效率和客户端代码的生成。 尽管近期的技术进步已利用大语言模型（LLM）从源代码中生成初始规范，但现有方法仍将此过程视为一次性事件——忽视了这些成果在持续验证、长期维护和市场需求驱动下的演化需求。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了 Agent4Spec，一个自主的多智能体框架，包含两条独立的流程：（1）验证流程，用于检测并自我修正 OpenAPI 的语法错误；（2）市场分析流程，用于开展竞争研究、识别与行业领导者相比的功能差距，并自动生成缺失的 API 规范功能。 我们在两个精心挑选的数据集上对 Agent4Spec 进行了评估，这些数据集涵盖了通用和工业场景的 API 规范。 在 9 款 SOTA LLM 中，表现最佳的模型实现了 100% 的语法错误检测率，以及对所提修正方案超过 95% 的实现成功率，同时其建议的端点改进获得了超过 50% 的采用率，这使其成为 API 开发中的实用工具。

paragraphs.en: API specifications define the operational contract between service providers and consumers. For REST services, OpenAPI Specification (OAS) documents describe endpoints, parameters, schemas, and error cases in a machine-readable form. Such specifications support client integration, API testing, and long-term maintenance, while inaccurate or incomplete specifications can mislead developers and propagate failures across downstream tools. As software ecosystems evolve, maintaining both the syntactic validity and practical relevance of these specifications becomes increasingly difficult.
paragraphs.zh: API 规范定义了服务提供者和消费者之间的操作契约。 对于 REST 服务，OpenAPI 规范（OAS）文档以机器可读的形式描述了端点、参数、模式和错误情况。 此类规范支持客户端集成、API 测试和长期维护，而不准确或不完整的规范则可能误导开发者，并在下游工具中引发故障蔓延。 随着软件生态系统的演进，维持这些规范的语法有效性和实际相关性变得越来越困难。

They provide limited support for the post-generation stage, where developers must validate full OAS files, implement repairs safely, and decide whether the API should evolve to match current market expectations.

paragraphs.en: To address this gap, we present Agent4Spec, a multi-agent system for post-stage API specification validation and enhancement. As shown in Figure 1 , Agent4Spec uses an orchestrator agent to route developer requests into two task-specific pipelines. The validation pipeline detects OAS syntax errors and proposes corrections through tool-assisted checking. The market analysis pipeline identifies the API domain, searches for competing services and current trends, analyzes functional gaps, and suggests endpoint-level improvements. A revision agent can then apply approved changes to the original specification, with optional human review before market-driven changes are implemented.
paragraphs.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们提出了 Agent4Spec——一个用于阶段后 API 规范验证与优化的多智能体系统。 如图 1 所示，Agent4Spec 使用一个协调智能体将开发者的请求引导至两条任务专用流程。 验证流程能够检测 OAS 语法错误，并通过工具辅助检查提出修正建议。 市场分析流程会识别 API 领域，搜索竞争服务和当前趋势，分析功能缺口，并提出端点级别的改进建议。 随后，修订智能体可将已批准的更改应用于原始规范，在实施市场驱动型变更前还可选择进行人工审核。

paragraphs.en: API specification generation has been studied from both implementation artifacts and public documentation. For source-code-based generation, Respector [ 8 ] uses static and symbolic program analysis to infer endpoint methods, parameters, responses, and constraints from REST API implementations. Recent LLM-based approaches extend this direction: LRASGen [ 5 ] generates RESTful API specifications from cleaned source code, while OOPS [ 9 ] models cross-file API dependencies and applies self-refinement to improve OpenAPI Specification (OAS) compliance. In parallel, documentation-based systems such as SpeCrawler [ 6 ] and OASBuilder [ 7 ] generate OAS files from online API documentation through scraping and LLM-based synthesis. These methods reduce the cost of producing initial specifications, but they mainly assume a specific generation setting. Agent4Spec instead targets the post-generation stage, where an existing OAS file must be validated, repaired, and potentially enhanced.
paragraphs.zh: API 规范生成已从实现产物和公开文档两个角度进行了研究。 对于基于源代码的生成方法，Respector [ 8 ] 利用静态和符号程序分析，从 REST API 实现中推断出端点方法、参数、响应和约束条件。 近期的 LLM 基于一方法延续了这一方向：LRASGen [ 5 ] 从清理后的源代码生成 RESTful API 规范，而 OOPS [ 9 ] 则对跨文件的 API 依赖进行建模，并通过自我优化提升对 OpenAPI Specification (OAS) 的合规性。 与此同时，基于文档的系统（如 SpeCrawler [ 6 ] 和 OASBuilder [ 7 ]）通过抓取和 LLM 辅助合成，从在线 API 文档中生成 OAS 文件。 这些方法降低了生成初始规范的成本，但它们主要假设了特定的生成设置。 Agent4Spec 则专注于生成后的阶段，即对现有的 OAS 文件进行验证、修复以及可能的增强。

paragraphs.en: Several studies examine whether LLMs can understand or update API documentation. Li et al. [ 2 ] evaluate LLM accuracy in API documentation understanding across programming languages, and Chen et al. [ 3 ] study retrieval-augmented API documentation for code generation. Lee et al. [ 4 ] move closer to maintenance by extracting API change rules from repository histories and prompting LLMs to update documentation snippets. These works show that LLMs can support API-documentation tasks, but they focus on textual documentation or downstream code assistance. In comparison, Agent4Spec focuses on machine-readable OAS artifacts and couples validation reports with full-specification revision.

paragraphs.en: LLM-based agentic systems have been widely applied to complex software engineering tasks [ 1 ] . ChatDev [ 11 ] , Agent4RE [ 30 ] , and MetaGPT [ 10 ] organize multiple agents into role-based software-development workflows, while SWE-agent [ 12 ] , Agent4cs [ 13 ] , and AutoCodeRover [ 14 ] focus on repository-level issue resolution and program improvement. These systems demonstrate the value of task decomposition, tool use, and iterative feedback for software development. However, they mainly operate on source code, repositories, or natural-language development tasks. We propose Agent4Spec to target machine-readable OAS maintenance, where the output must remain syntactically valid, structurally consistent, and controllable by developers before endpoint-level changes are applied.

sents.en: We propose Agent4Spec to target machine-readable OAS maintenance, where the output must remain syntactically valid, structurally consistent, and controllable by developers before endpoint-level changes are applied.
sents.zh: 我们提出 Agent4Spec，专门针对机器可读的 OAS 维护，其输出必须保持语法有效、结构一致，并在应用端点级变更前可由开发者进行控制。

paragraphs.en: As illustrated in Figure 1 , Agent4Spec starts with an orchestrator agent A o A_{o} , which serves as the central coordinator – interacting with the developers while controlling over all other specialized sub-agents. Once an API specification S 0 S_{0} is received, the orchestrator directs the workflow based on the user’s query – either triggering the validation agent to detect syntax errors in the document, or forwarding it to a series of market research agents to identify current technology trends and leading API service competitors. Notably, only one of these two pathways is executed before calling the revision agent, ensuring that the system is not overwhelmed with excessive revision instructions. Optionally, human developers can be incorporated into this workflow before the revision agent is triggered, reviewing and selectively approving the suggestions produced by either the validation or market analysis pipelines.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate Agent4Spec across both general-purpose and industrial API ecosystems, we have curated two datasets of OpenAPI specifications with complementary features: 1) Guru-Spec contains 300 publicly available API specifications collected from APIs.guru [ 18 ] , covering diverse domains such as cloud services, finance, e-commerce, and transportation. 2) In contrast, Industry-Spec focuses on 200 industrial APIs obtained from Xcelerator Developer [ 17 ] . These APIs target industrial applications and enterprise services, covering domains such as automation, Internet of Things, asset management, and manufacturing. Together, these two datasets enable evaluation across both broad web services and industrial scenarios. Detailed statistics are presented in Table II .
paragraphs.zh: 为了在通用和工业 API 生态系统中对 Agent4Spec 进行全面评估，我们精心挑选了两组具有互补特性的 OpenAPI 规范数据集：1) Guru-Spec 包含从 APIs.guru [ 18 ] 收集的 300 个公开可用的 API 规范，涵盖云服务、金融、电子商务和交通等多个领域。2) 相比之下，Industry-Spec 则专注于从 Xcelerator Developer [ 17 ] 获取的 200 个工业 API。 这些 API 面向工业应用和企业服务，涵盖自动化、物联网、资产管理和制造等领域。 这两组数据集共同支持了对广泛网络服务和工业场景的综合评估。 详细统计数据见表 II。

paragraphs.en: We select an extensive set of evaluation metrics tailored to each task. For syntax validation – a task with verifiable outputs, we use quantitative metrics, including 1) error detection rate (the percentage of errors identified by the system), 2) solution proposal rate (the percentage of detected errors for which solutions are proposed), 3) solution correctness (the percentage of proposed solutions that are accurate). For API specification revision, we employ 1) correct implementation rate (the percentage of solutions that are properly implemented), and 2) successful save rate (the percentage of solutions locally saved).
paragraphs.zh: 我们为每个任务选择了一套广泛且量身定制的评估指标。 对于语法验证——一个具有可验证输出的任务，我们使用定量指标，包括：1）错误检测率（系统识别出的错误所占百分比），2）解决方案提出率（对已检测到的错误提出解决方案的百分比），3）解决方案正确性（所提解决方案中准确无误的百分比）。 对于 API 规范修订，我们采用：1）正确实现率（被正确实现的解决方案所占百分比），以及 2）成功保存率（在本地成功保存的解决方案所占百分比）。

sents.zh: 我们为每个任务选择了一套广泛且量身定制的评估指标。

sents.en: For syntax validation – a task with verifiable outputs, we use quantitative metrics, including 1) error detection rate (the percentage of errors identified by the system), 2) solution proposal rate (the percentage of detected errors for which solutions are proposed), 3) solution correctness (the percentage of proposed solutions that are accurate).

sents.en: For API specification revision, we employ 1) correct implementation rate (the percentage of solutions that are properly implemented), and 2) successful save rate (the percentage of solutions locally saved).
sents.zh: 对于 API 规范修订，我们采用：1）正确实现率（被正确实现的解决方案所占百分比），以及 2）成功保存率（在本地成功保存的解决方案所占百分比）。

paragraphs.en: Regarding market analysis, where no groundtruth answers are available, we apply LLM-as-a-judge [ 15 ] complemented by human evaluation. To be more specific, 1) LLM-as-a-judge employs prompt-based assessment, with grades assigned on a scale from 1 to 5. Given the empirical evidence that smaller LLMs often struggle in judging summary quality and even the best one frequently misjudges [ 16 ] , we only employ the most competent large-scale models – Claude-Sonnet-4.6, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and GPT-5.2. In comparison, 2) human evaluation verifies the consistency of LLM-as-a-judge. Three software developers assess summaries independently on a scale from 1 to 5, with final scores averaged for fairness. We selected human evaluators based on their software development experience, code-review skills, and relevant domain expertise. Finally, we chose two senior software engineers, each with three years of development experience, and one junior software developer in industry. In addition to their own experience and judgment criteria, we also provided the prompt and grading schema used in LLM-as-a-judge to ensure consistent evaluation. paragraphs.en: Table IV compares Agent4Spec with a single-prompt baseline, where the same LLM is asked to handle validation in one prompt. Across all evaluated models and datasets, Agent4Spec outperformed the baseline in error detection, solution proposal, and solution correctness. When T v T_{v} was invoked reliably, Agent4Spec detected nearly all syntax errors: Claude-Sonnet-4.6 and Gemini-3.1-Pro reached 100.0% detection on both datasets, while GPT-5.2 and GPT-4.1 remained above 99.0%. GPT-4o was slightly lower, but still detected 96.0% of errors on Guru-Spec and 94.5% on Industry-Spec. The system proposed a repair for every error it detected, as reflected in the identical percentages for detected errors and proposed solutions. Regarding the correctness of solutions, frontier models achieved 91.5–99.5% correctness, while Qwen-3.5-9B and Ministral-3-8B dropped to 87.0% and 87.5% on Industry-Spec. The other two compact models LLaMA-3.1-8B and Gemma-4-4B showed a typical failure mode: they often stated that they would use T v T_{v} but failed to activate it, yielding detection rates and correct-solution rates no higher than 8.0%.
paragraphs.zh: 表 IV 将 Agent4Spec 与单提示词基线模型进行了比较，其中相同的 LLM 被要求通过单个提示词处理验证。 在所有评估的模型和数据集中，Agent4Spec 在错误检测、解决方案提出和解决方案正确性方面均优于基线模型。 当 T v T_{v} 能够可靠调用时，Agent4Spec 几乎检测到了所有语法错误：Claude-Sonnet-4.6 和 Gemini-3.1-Pro 在这两个数据集上的检测率均达到 100.0%，而 GPT-5.2 和 GPT-4.1 的检测结果仍高于 99.0%。 GPT-4o 的表现略低，但在 Guru-Spec 上仍检测到了 96.0% 的错误，在 Industry-Spec 上检测到了 94.5% 的错误。 系统为每个检测到的错误都提出了修复方案，这一点体现在检测到的错误数量与提出的解决方案数量百分比完全一致。 关于解决方案的正确性，前沿模型的正确率达到了 91.5%–99.5%，而 Qwen-3.5-9B 和 Ministral-3-8B 在 Industry-Spec 上的正确率则降至 87.0% 和 87.5%。 另外两款紧凑型模型 LLaMA-3.1-8B 和 Gemma-4-4B 表现出典型的故障模式：它们通常会声称会使用 T v T_{v}，但未能成功激活，导致检测率和正确解决方案率均未超过 8.0%。

paragraphs.en: Table V evaluates whether the single-prompt baseline and Agent4Spec can implement the proposed fixes and save a complete revised specification in its first attempt. This task is more demanding than syntax-error detection because the revision agent must modify the full API specification file while preserving its original structure. Compared with the baseline, Agent4Spec generally achieved higher correct-implementation and save rates. Large-scale frontier models saved almost all revised specifications, with Claude-Sonnet-4.6, Gemini-3.1-Pro, GPT-5.2, and GPT-4.1 reaching 100.0% save rates on both datasets. Their correct-implementation rates were lower, ranging from 82.0% to 98.3% on Guru-Spec and from 73.5% to 98.5% on Industry-Spec. This gap shows that saving and correctness are separate tool functions: an agent may save a revised specification even when the implemented solution is incorrect. In comparison, compact open-weight models struggled in the full-spec revision setting. Qwen-3.5-9B achieved only 10.3% and 5.5% correct implementation on Guru-Spec and Industry-Spec, while Ministral-3-8B, LLaMA-3.1-8B, and Gemma-4-4B were close to zero. These results indicate that full-specification revision remains challenging for smaller models. Iterative re-validation after each revision attempt is necessary to verify the quality of generated API specifications.
paragraphs.zh: 表 V 评估了单提示词基线模型和 Agent4Spec 是否能够实施所提出的修复方案，并在首次尝试中保存一份完整的修订后规范。 这项任务比语法错误检测更具挑战性，因为修订智能体必须在不改变原始结构的前提下修改整个 API 规范文件。 与基线模型相比，Agent4Spec 通常实现了更高的正确实施率和保存率。 大规模前沿模型几乎能够保存所有修订后的规范，其中 Claude-Sonnet-4.6、Gemini-3.1-Pro、GPT-5.2 和 GPT-4.1 在两个数据集上的保存率均达到了 100.0%。 它们的正确实施率则较低，在 Guru-Spec 上的正确率为 82.0% 至 98.3%，在 Industry-Spec 上则为 73.5% 至 98.5%。 这一差距表明，保存和正确性是两个独立的工具功能：即使实施方案不正确，智能体仍可能保存修订后的规范。 相比之下，小型开放权重模型在全规范修订任务中表现不佳。 Qwen-3.5-9B 在 Guru-Spec 和 Industry-Spec 上的正确实施率分别仅为 10.3% 和 5.5%，而 Ministral-3-8B、LLaMA-3.1-8B 和 Gemma-4-4B 的实施率接近于零。 这些结果表明，对于较小的模型而言，完整规范的修订仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。 在每次修订尝试之后进行迭代重新验证，是确保所生成 API 规范质量的关键。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 shows that this task is comparatively tractable, with human scores ranging from 2.76 to 3.82 on the 5-point scale. paragraphs.en: Figure 4 shows a clear advantage for frontier models, although the exact ranking varies by evaluator. Human evaluators rate Claude-Sonnet-4.6 highest at 4.74, followed by GPT-4.1 at 4.48 and both GPT-5.2 and Gemini-3.1-Pro at 4.36. Gemini-3.1-Pro as judge assigns similarly high scores to the frontier group, with Claude-Sonnet-4.6, GPT-5.2, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and GPT-4.1 all scoring above 4.70. By contrast, Claude-Sonnet-4.6 is substantially more conservative as an evaluator, assigning no model above 2.10. GPT-5.2 shows a self-preference pattern, giving its own output the highest score of 4.02, compared with 3.26 for GPT-4.1 and 3.04 for Claude-Sonnet-4.6. Compact models remain weaker overall, especially LLaMA-3.1-8B, which receives near-minimal scores from LLM judges and only 1.82 from human evaluators. This weakness is consistent with the online-search results: when compact models underuse retrieved evidence and rely more on prior knowledge, the downstream gap analysis has a weaker factual basis and performance degrades.

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows that this requirement separates models more sharply than earlier stages. Human evaluators rate GPT-4.1 highest at 4.56, followed by Claude-Sonnet-4.6 at 4.44 and Gemini-3.1-Pro at 3.94. Gemini-3.1-Pro as judge gives the highest score 4.96 to Claude-Sonnet-4.6, followed by GPT-4.1 (4.66), Gemini-3.1-Pro (4.64), and GPT-4o (4.52). GPT-5.2 underperforms relative to the strongest frontier models, receiving 3.46 from Gemini-3.1-Pro as judge and 3.04 from both GPT-5.2 and human evaluators. Claude-Sonnet-4.6 remains conservative as a judge, assigning all models scores between 1.02 and 1.58. Qualitative inspection suggests that GPT-5.2 and Qwen-3.5-9B often prioritize the generation of market insights report and ignore the request of endpoints improvement, leading to significantly biased results and lower scores. paragraphs.en: We further evaluate the human-in-the-loop mode in the market analysis pipeline. Each agent is instructed to provide market insights along with three endpoint suggestions, and human developers record how many suggestions they would approve for specification revision. Figure 6 reports the average number of approved suggestions out of three. For Agent4Spec, proprietary models substantially outperform compact open-weight models, with GPT-5.2 achieving the highest acceptance score of 1.82 out of 3, followed closely by Claude-Sonnet-4.6 (1.79), Gemini-3.1-Pro (1.73), and GPT-4.1 (1.71). GPT-4o remains lower at 1.48, but still exceeds all compact models. Among compact models, Qwen-3.5-9B and Ministral-3-8B achieve 0.78 and 0.74 accepted suggestions, while Gemma-4-4B and LLaMA-3.1-8B remain near 0.33. These results indicate that stronger tool use and reasoning improve endpoint-suggestion quality. However, even the best model averages fewer than two accepted suggestions, highlighting the value of human review before applying market-driven API changes in practice.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进一步评估了市场分析流程中“人在回路”模式的表现。 每个智能体都被要求提供市场洞察以及三个端点建议，而人类开发者则记录他们愿意批准多少个建议用于规范修订。 图6报告了三个建议中被批准的平均数量。 对于 Agent4Spec，专有模型的表现显著优于轻量级开源模型，其中 GPT-5.2 获得了最高的接受分数 1.82（满分 3），紧随其后的是 Claude-Sonnet-4.6（1.79）、Gemini-3.1-Pro（1.73）和 GPT-4.1（1.71）。 GPT-4o 的得分仍较低，为 1.48，但依然超过了所有轻量级模型。 在轻量级模型中，Qwen-3.5-9B 和 Ministral-3-8B 分别获得了 0.78 和 0.74 个被接受的建议，而 Gemma-4-4B 和 LLaMA-3.1-8B 则接近 0.33。 这些结果表明，更强的工具使用能力和推理能力能够提升端点建议的质量。 然而，即便是表现最佳的模型，其平均被接受的建议数也少于两个，这凸显了在实践中应用市场驱动的 API 变更之前进行人工审查的重要性。

paragraphs.en: Figure 7 reports the average output-token usage and inference latency per API specification under our experimental deployment. Compact open-weight models are served locally with Ollama on a single Apple M4 Pro machine with a 12-core CPU, 16-core GPU. Frontier models are accessed through API gateways, and all models use the minimum temperature setting. Because the input length is largely determined by the API specification itself, output tokens provide a clearer measure of model-side generation cost. Syntax validation is consistently more efficient than online search. Across models, validation consumes 162–1,402 output tokens, whereas online search requires 720–5,467 output tokens, due to its four-stage design and tool-assisted web searches. The same pattern appears in latency: validation completes in 1.8–37.1 seconds, while online search takes 16.1–182.2 seconds. Locally deployed compact models are especially latency-bound, with Ministral-3-8B and Qwen-3.5-9B requiring 173.2 and 182.2 seconds for online search respectively. Gemma-4-4B and LLaMA-3.1-8B take less time since they may fail to invoke the tools and directly end the session. In contrast, API-based frontier models complete online search much faster, ranging from 16.1 seconds for GPT-4.1 to 36.0 seconds for Gemini-3.1-Pro. Claude-Sonnet-4.6 produces the longest online-search outputs (5,467 tokens), but its API latency remains moderate at 18.9 seconds. These results show that model deployment mode and task complexity jointly determine the resource consumption.
paragraphs.zh: 图 7 报告了我们在实验部署中，每种 API 规范下的平均输出令牌使用量和推理延迟。 紧凑型开放权重模型通过 Ollama 在单台配备 12 核 CPU 和 16 核 GPU 的 Apple M4 Pro 机器上本地提供服务。 Frontier 模型通过 API 网关访问，且所有模型均使用最低的温度设置。 由于输入长度主要由 API 规范本身决定，因此输出令牌能更清晰地反映模型侧的生成成本。 语法验证始终比在线搜索更高效。 在不同模型中，验证消耗 162–1,402 个输出令牌，而在线搜索则需要 720–5,467 个输出令牌，这是由于其四阶段设计和工具辅助的网页搜索所致。 延迟也呈现出相同趋势：验证在 1.8–37.1 秒内完成，而在线搜索则需要 16.1–182.2 秒。 本地部署的紧凑型模型尤其受延迟限制，其中 Ministral-3-8B 和 Qwen-3.5-9B 进行在线搜索分别需要 173.2 秒和 182.2 秒。 Gemma-4-4B 和 LLaMA-3.1-8B 所需时间较短，因为它们可能无法调用工具并直接结束会话。 相比之下，基于 API 的 Frontier 模型完成在线搜索的速度快得多，从 GPT-4.1 的 16.1 秒到 Gemini-3.1-Pro 的 36.0 秒不等。 Claude-Sonnet-4.6 产生的在线搜索结果最长（5,467 个令牌），但其 API 延迟仍保持在 18.9 秒的中等水平。 这些结果表明，模型部署模式与任务复杂性共同决定了资源消耗情况。

sents.zh: 紧凑型开放权重模型通过 Ollama 在单台配备 12 核 CPU 和 16 核 GPU 的 Apple M4 Pro 机器上本地提供服务。

sents.en: Frontier models are accessed through API gateways, and all models use the minimum temperature setting.
sents.zh: Frontier 模型通过 API 网关访问，且所有模型均使用最低的温度设置。

sents.en: Because the input length is largely determined by the API specification itself, output tokens provide a clearer measure of model-side generation cost.
sents.zh: 由于输入长度主要由 API 规范本身决定，因此输出令牌能更清晰地反映模型侧的生成成本。

sents.en: Syntax validation is consistently more efficient than online search.
sents.zh: 语法验证始终比在线搜索更高效。

sents.en: Across models, validation consumes 162–1,402 output tokens, whereas online search requires 720–5,467 output tokens, due to its four-stage design and tool-assisted web searches.
sents.zh: 在不同模型中，验证消耗 162–1,402 个输出令牌，而在线搜索则需要 720–5,467 个输出令牌，这是由于其四阶段设计和工具辅助的网页搜索所致。

sents.en: The same pattern appears in latency: validation completes in 1.8–37.1 seconds, while online search takes 16.1–182.2 seconds.
sents.zh: 延迟也呈现出相同趋势：验证在 1.8–37.1 秒内完成，而在线搜索则需要 16.1–182.2 秒。

sents.en: Locally deployed compact models are especially latency-bound, with Ministral-3-8B and Qwen-3.5-9B requiring 173.2 and 182.2 seconds for online search respectively.
sents.zh: 本地部署的紧凑型模型尤其受延迟限制，其中 Ministral-3-8B 和 Qwen-3.5-9B 进行在线搜索分别需要 173.2 秒和 182.2 秒。

sents.en: Gemma-4-4B and LLaMA-3.1-8B take less time since they may fail to invoke the tools and directly end the session.
sents.zh: Gemma-4-4B 和 LLaMA-3.1-8B 所需时间较短，因为它们可能无法调用工具并直接结束会话。

sents.en: In contrast, API-based frontier models complete online search much faster, ranging from 16.1 seconds for GPT-4.1 to 36.0 seconds for Gemini-3.1-Pro.
sents.zh: 相比之下，基于 API 的 Frontier 模型完成在线搜索的速度快得多，从 GPT-4.1 的 16.1 秒到 Gemini-3.1-Pro 的 36.0 秒不等。

sents.en: Claude-Sonnet-4.6 produces the longest online-search outputs (5,467 tokens), but its API latency remains moderate at 18.9 seconds.
sents.zh: Claude-Sonnet-4.6 产生的在线搜索结果最长（5,467 个令牌），但其 API 延迟仍保持在 18.9 秒的中等水平。

sents.en: These results show that model deployment mode and task complexity jointly determine the resource consumption.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，模型部署模式与任务复杂性共同决定了资源消耗情况。

paragraphs.en: This paper presents Agent4Spec, a multi-agent framework that supports both technical validation and market-driven improvement of OpenAPI specifications. Experiments on Guru-Spec and Industry-Spec datasets show that the framework is highly effective when paired with frontier LLMs. Claude-Sonnet-4.6 and Gemini-3.1-Pro achieve complete syntax-error detection on both datasets, while other frontier models remain close to this level. The results also show that full-specification revision is more difficult than error diagnosis, since successful file generation does not always imply a correct repair. For market-driven improvement, we observe similar patterns, where larger models produce more relevant and timely outputs across the four sequential stages. Human evaluation further confirms the practical value of the suggested API endpoints. Resource measurements show that task complexity and deployment mode jointly determine cost: market analysis is token-intensive, while locally deployed compact models require long inference latency. Overall, Agent4Spec shows that LLM agents can advance API maintenance beyond static validation, but reliable deployment still depends on model capability, tool usage, verification, and human oversight.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了 Agent4Spec，一个多智能体框架，支持对 OpenAPI 规范进行技术验证和市场驱动改进。 在 Guru-Spec 和 Industry-Spec 数据集上的实验表明，该框架与前沿 LLM 结合使用时效果显著。 Claude-Sonnet-4.6 和 Gemini-3.1-Pro 在这两个数据集上都实现了完整的语法错误检测，而其他前沿模型的表现也接近这一水平。 结果还显示，完整规范的修订比错误诊断更为困难，因为成功生成文件并不总是意味着修复正确。 在市场驱动改进方面，我们观察到类似的模式：在四个连续阶段中，规模更大的模型能产生更具相关性和及时性的输出。 人类评估进一步证实了所建议的 API 端点的实用价值。 资源测量显示，任务复杂度和部署模式共同决定了成本：市场分析需要大量 token，而本地部署的紧凑型模型则需要较长的推理延迟。 总体而言，Agent4Spec 表明 LLM 智能体能够将 API 维护从静态验证提升到更高水平，但可靠的部署仍然取决于模型能力、工具使用、验证和人类监督。

paragraphs.en: Future work should extend experiments to more emerging models to generalize the observed trade-offs in accuracy, token cost, and latency. Furthermore, exploring specialized prompting strategies, supervision mechanisms, or fine-tuning approaches may improve models’ tool-use reliability and make local deployment more practical for API maintenance tasks. Given that no public benchmark is available for OpenAPI specification repair, our experiments rely on manually injected common errors, including invalid data types, missing required fields, and structural inconsistencies. Future work should develop a repair benchmark from real-world version histories and issue reports, where faulty and corrected API specifications can be paired directly.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作应将实验扩展到更多新兴模型，以推广在准确性、令牌成本和延迟方面观察到的权衡关系。 此外，探索专门的提示策略、监督机制或微调方法，可能会提高模型使用工具的可靠性，并使本地部署在 API 维护任务中更具实用性。 鉴于目前尚无可用于 OpenAPI 规范修复的公开基准，我们的实验依赖于手动注入的常见错误，包括无效的数据类型、缺失的必填字段和结构不一致问题。 未来的工作应基于真实世界的版本历史和问题报告开发一个修复基准，以便可以直接将错误的 API 规范与修正后的规范进行配对。
